## Problem

What problem does this solve? Describe the situation, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see?

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## Scope

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] New or improved agent adapter
- [ ] Installer / CLI
- [ ] Validator
- [ ] Documentation

## Additional context

Links to vendor documentation (for adapters), examples, or related skills.
Do not include secrets.
